title: Telehealth Interpretation for Clinical Teams
summary: Learn how telehealth interpretation works across pre-visit setup, interpreter connection, audio, phone visits, clinical discussion.
body_markdown:
###


The interpreter may join the same video visit, connect by phone, or real-time AI medical interpretation may run alongside the virtual encounter. The setup should allow the patient and clinician to hear and respond without audio overlap.


###


Yes. AI medical interpretation can support real-time virtual care when the system works across the devices and channels used by the clinical team and patient.


###


Overlapping speech and unstable audio are common problems because they can remove parts of the source conversation before interpretation even occurs.


###


Pause the clinical discussion, restore audio or switch to a backup connection, restart interpretation, and repeat the last clinically important statement before continuing.


###


Review medications, testing, referrals, follow-up timing, return precautions, and the patient's questions through interpretation before ending the call.
